summary.text: Mary Freitas is a Democratic former state representative seeking to return to the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 26, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former reading specialist and Title I coordinator, Freitas served in the House from 2014 to 2024, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Mary Freitas was born in Manchester, New Hampshire, and graduated from Central High School in 1956.

Freitas earned a degree from Plymouth Teachers College in 1960 and from the University of New Hampshire in 1968, and her career experience includes working as a reading specialist and Title I coordinator.
Freitas has volunteered with the Manchester Historic Association and the New Hampshire Retired Educators Association.
Freitas served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives from 2014 to 2024, first from Hillsborough 14 and, after winning in 2022, from Hillsborough 26.
Freitas served on the Health, Human Services and Elderly Affairs Committee in several sessions, including 2023-2024, and on the Election Law Committee in 2021-2022.
